note: Catalogue-scoped display names, keyed by MusicBrainz artist MBID. Use the name these songs are well known under in this karaoke catalogue — not the venue string, not necessarily today's primary, and not a generic 'most famous ever' label. Optional `slug` overrides the URL path when slugifying the display name would be awkward (P!nk → pink). The same slug on two MBIDs merges them onto one artist page: for leader+band splits the page is the front figure, while song rows keep the full credit. Humans only; no script writes this file. Unmapped artists fall back to the MusicBrainz primary (with stylization rules in build-resolved).
